label: Image
when: one picture from the media library, with an optional caption (a photo of the team, the shop, a product)
rules: One picture, only from "The site's media library": write {"id":<ID>,"sizeSlug":"large","linkDestination":"none"}, the img src is its exact address, alt is its alt text from the list (or a short description), and class="wp-image-<ID>" goes after alt on the img. The example's address is a stand-in without an id: replace it. Never an address that is not in the list; if none fits, or the library is empty, write no image. The figcaption is optional: a short caption in the page's language. No width, height, align, link or other attributes.
